03

Scope & safety

This course teaches observation, handbuilding, testing, and diagnostic reasoning. It does not replace local instruction for kilns, ventilation, glaze chemistry, electrical or fuel systems, or occupational health. Material labels, studio rules, kiln manuals, and qualified supervision take precedence.

Essential habitsUse wet cleanup; do not dry sweep or use compressed air on clay dust. Avoid casual dry sanding. Keep food and drink out of material areas. Know every material you use. Fire only in approved, ventilated equipment under authorized supervision.
